newsitem.title: USA: Fusion Medical wins FDA OK for electrode.
newsitem.headline: Fusion Medical wins FDA OK for electrode.

text.p: Fusion Medical Technologies Inc on Monday said it has received marketing approval for its SilverBullet electrode from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The SilverBullett allows the use of standard operating room equipment to apply Fusion's RapiSeal patch, a wound seal that does not perforate or stress skin tissue.

"We believe that this product will facilitate the use of the RapiSeal Patch and significantly expand our customer base by eliminating the need for (special equipment)," Philip Sawyer, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
The RapiSeal patch was approved by the FDA in June 1996.
